title: Neuroscientist discusses his experiences of sharing a dream realm with a friend and his thoughts on the telepathy tapes and a paradigm shift.
content: Highly interesting discussion. Fast forward to 12:30. He talks about his experience of sharing a dreamspace with his friend on the same night. I have also experienced this dream telepathy with my partner once a few years ago where we both dreamt about the same storyline from different perspectives at the same time next to each other (see my post history). Also makes me think about mall world and how many of us are seemingly interacting with the same places. Seems like a lot of people with scientific backgrounds are taking these alternative concepts on consciousness seriously.
